name: Positive predictive value (PPV)
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "If a test says 'cancer', the chance it is right."
fields.after: "Positive predictive value (PPV) is the chance that a test saying 'cancer' is right."

fields.before: "True positives / all positives. Depends on prevalence: a screening test with 99.5% specificity in a population with 1% cancer prevalence has PPV ~50-60%. Central to evaluating MCED tests like Galleri."
